chunks: And from him, from Fadalah, from Rifa'ah ibn Musa, who said:
I heard Aba 'Abd Allah عليه السلام saying: 'Ali عليه السلام, when he rose from the first two rak'ahs, would say: “By Your power and Your strength I rise and sit.”

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the narrator being quoted in the report
key_terms.أَقُومُ: I rise; standing up in salat (prayer)
key_terms.الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأَوَّلَتَيْنِ: the first two units of salat (prayer)
key_terms.بِحَوْلِكَ: by Your power; an expression of dependence on Allah
key_terms.عَلِيٌّ: Imam 'Ali عليه السلام, whose practice is being described

ai.seo_question: What did Imam 'Ali عليه السلام say when rising after the first two rak'ahs in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a supplication recited by Amir al-Mu'minin 'Ali عليه السلام when rising after the first two rak'ahs of salat (prayer). It expresses reliance upon Allah alone for movement and strength within worship, and is relevant to the etiquettes and recommended remembrances of salat (prayer).
